blocks.title: Algorithm efficiency
blocks.text: Algorithm efficiency yeh hai ke algorithm waqt aur memory jaise wasail kitni achhi tarah istemal karta hai, us ki time aur space complexity se parkhi jati hai.
Bubble Sort O(n^2) hai: input dugna karne se taqreeban chaar guna waqt lagta hai. Merge Sort O(n log n) hai, jo kahin aahista barhta hai, to bare datasets ke liye zyada kaarkard hai.

blocks.prompt: Bare datasets ke liye kaunsa zyada kaarkard hai: Bubble Sort, Merge Sort, Selection Sort ya Quick Sort (MCQ 5)?
blocks.explanation: (b) Merge Sort, jise chapter bare datasets ke liye kaarkard kehta hai; Quick Sort (d) bhi ausatan O(n log n) hai. Sawal 'search algorithm' kehta hai magar tamam options sorting algorithms hain.

items: Efficiency: istemal shuda wasail; bubble sort O(n^2) (dugne input par 4 guna) banam merge sort O(n log n).
